items.title: Navigator
items.text: Navigator: Once on your turn, you may do the Chart Sea Lane action without spending any Supply cubes.

mechanics.trigger: When you do the Chart Sea Lane action
mechanics.effect: Do the Chart Sea Lane action without spending any Supply cubes.

items.title: Investigator
items.text: Investigator: Once on your turn, as an action, discard a Player card to take a City card from the Player discard pile.

mechanics.effect: Discard a Player card to take a City card from the Player discard pile.
restrictions: The taken card is a City card from the Player discard pile
The discarded card is any Player card

items.title: Soldier
items.text: Soldier: Discard a City card matching the color of the city you are leaving to prevent exposure from Hollow Men figures in that city.

mechanics.trigger: When you would be exposed by Hollow Men figures in the city you are leaving
mechanics.effect: Discard a City card matching the color of the city you are leaving to prevent that exposure.
restrictions: The discarded City card must match the color of the city you are leaving
Prevents exposure from Hollow Men figures in that city

items.title: CHARACTER ABILITIES
items.text:
CHARACTER ABILITIES
Add these to your pool of character abilities.

Investigator: Once on your turn, as an action, discard a Player card to take a City card from the Player discard pile. (3)

Soldier: Discard a City card matching the color of the city you are leaving to prevent exposure from Hollow Men figures in that city. (2)

Navigator: Once on your turn, you may do the Chart Sea Lane action without spending any Supply cubes. (1)

mechanics.effect: Add these stickers to the pool of character abilities.

summary: Three character abilities and the pool card that prices them. Investigator 3, Soldier 2, Navigator 1. Soldier is not printed as an action; it is a discard when leaving a city. Corner badge on the pool card is 29.
